'''Salana Rok''' was a [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] female gunnery officer in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Formerly an underworld enforcer, Salana's intensity for violence against her enemies and strong proficiency in weapons are fit for her duties as a starfighter gunner. Hidden by her aggressive personality is a loner persona, always in search for a home.
